name: slim
tagline: Strip verbose CLI output before it hits the LLM.
description: A pluggable pipe filter that trims noise from big command output — huge YAML/JSON dumps, lockfiles, long diffs, verbose install logs — so an agent spends its context budget on signal. Always-on lossless cleanups (ANSI, blank runs, repeats) plus opt-in per-command clamps to head+tail with a clear elision marker. Pure Python standard library.
